q1: SELECT b1.name AS bar1, b2.name AS bar2 FROM bar AS b1, bar AS b2 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT s1.beer FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND s2.beer = s1.beer)) AND EXISTS(SELECT s2.beer FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name AND s1.beer = s2.beer))
q2: SELECT s1.bar AS bar1, s2.bar AS bar2 FROM serves AS s1 JOIN serves AS s2 ON s1.beer = s2.beer WHERE s1.bar <> s2.bar GROUP BY s1.bar, s2.bar HAVING COUNT(s1.beer) < (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serves AS s3 WHERE s3.bar = s1.bar) AND COUNT(s1.beer) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serves AS s4 WHERE s4.bar = s1.bar AND s4.beer IN (SELECT beer FROM serves AS s5 WHERE s5.bar = s2.bar))
